title: Inverted Clamp FISH Ligation Protocol
author: Benjamin Emert
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qxwdxpe
materials: NEB Monarch PCR and DNA cleanup kit
Column purify using NEB Monarch PCR and DNA cleanup kit according to the manufacturer's instructions. Use 1 column per 10μL ligation reactions.

Column purify using NEB Monarch PCR and DNA cleanup kit according to the manufacturer's instructions. Use 1 column per 10μL ligation reactions.

steps.title: Reconstitute Oligos
steps.instruction: Reconstitute invertedClampFISH arms, backbones, and adaptors to 400uM in nuclease free water.

substeps.instruction: If the quantity of backbone oligos is very low, reconstitute to 200uM and use twice as much for subsequent reactions.

steps.title: Phosphorylate Backbone Oligos
steps.instruction: Combine reaction components to phosphorylate unmodified backbone oligos using 2x T7 DNA ligase buffer, 400uM backbone oligo, T4 polynucleotide kinase (PNK), and nuclease free water.

substeps.instruction: If adding the same invertedClampFISH arms to each backbone oligo, phosphorylation and ligation can be performed with multiple backbone oligos simultaneously (up to 30 probes, scaling reaction 2x-3x).
Incubate the PNK reaction in a thermal cycler for 8 hours (shorter durations or overnight incubation are also acceptable).

steps.title: Prepare Ligation Reaction
steps.instruction: Combine the following reaction components: 400μM left arm, 400μM right arm, 400μM left adapter, and 400μM right adapter.

steps.title: Denature and Anneal Oligos
steps.instruction: Heat the reaction components to 95ºC for 5 minutes using a thermal cycler, then cool slowly to 12ºC at a rate of 0.1ºC/sec.

steps.title: Perform Ligation
steps.instruction: Bring the reaction to room temperature, add T7 DNA ligase, mix, and centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature overnight (12 hours).
If any oligos contain a dye, incubate in the dark.

steps.title: Prepare for Column Purification
steps.instruction: Add 30 μL nuclease free water to the ligation reaction, followed by 350 μL binding buffer.

substeps.instruction: Scale volumes as needed, ensuring 7x volume of binding buffer is added before loading the column (e.g., scaling so 200 μL is loaded per column).

steps.title: Purify DNA via Monarch Column
steps.instruction: Apply the mixture to a Monarch column and centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 1 minute.

substeps.instruction: Remove flow-through and apply 200 μL Monarch DNA wash buffer; centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 1 minute.
Repeat the wash with another 200 μL Monarch DNA wash buffer and centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 1 minute (flow-through removal between washes is not required).
Transfer the column to a clean centrifuge tube and centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 1 minute to remove residual wash buffer.

steps.title: Elute Probes
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a clean centrifuge tube for elution and apply 30uL nuclease-free water to the column.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 1 minute to elute probes.
Note: Elution volume can be scaled to adjust final concentration (30 μL typically yields 50-80ng/μL).

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the eluted probes using a Nanodrop.

substeps.instruction: Set the absorbance constant to 33 for ssDNA.
